prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Reference/edit source: the attached Mediterranean hillside cutout. Its scenery, region and restrained warm lighting are right, but it must be recomposed into a MUCH wider real panorama, with smaller buildings, rather than stretching this existing composition.

Production game texture spec:
Create one continuous, naturally proportioned photographic panorama of Mediterranean countryside with a varied small hillside town, whitewashed and limestone houses, terracotta roofs, olive groves, dark umbrella pines, cypresses, winding lanes and low stone terraces. Show 35–60 small varied buildings distributed through the view. Every building should occupy only approximately 1–2 percent of the entire panorama width. No large hero villa or giant foreground tree. Doors, windows, roofs and trees must have normal real-world proportions.

CRITICAL LAYOUT: Use a wide 3:1 transparent PNG canvas, ideally 3840 x 1280. Within this canvas, the ACTUAL LANDSCAPE must be a very long shallow panoramic strip approximately 7:1 or 8:1, spanning the full width but occupying only the MIDDLE approximately 40 percent of canvas height. Leave ample genuinely transparent padding ABOVE and BELOW this narrow landscape strip. This transparent padding is intentional; the game will select the landscape's UV rectangle. Do NOT fill the whole canvas height with a tall hillside. Do NOT simply vertically squash the reference; create a wider stitched panorama with more countryside and small natural buildings. Think a 240-degree cylindrical photographic panorama, with undistorted small houses and low rolling hills.

The top silhouette has layered low ridges and irregular realistic trees. The bottom silhouette is a broad gently irregular grassy foothill with low scrub, dry olive-green meadow and small rocks, suitable for blending into real 3D ground. Keep a coherent, almost level natural grassy base across most of the strip. At the extreme first and last 5 percent of its width, descend into a few low coastal limestone rocks that finish at the base level; those tips must be small and low. No floating isolated elements or disconnected pieces. Transparent sky ABOVE the ridge and transparent space BELOW the base, no painted sky and no painted sea.

Style: realistic photographic distant environment, premium naturalistic game matte painting, convincing architectural scale, organic uneven terrain and foliage. Fine varied detail with atmospheric depth, soft warm early-evening diffuse light, neutral cream stone, muted olive and dusty green meadow, subtle umber, no extreme orange cast or black shadows. The game supplies final lighting.
No text, labels, border, checkerboard pixels, collage divisions, separate tiles, UI, people, cars near camera or game foreground structures. One connected long narrow landscape cutout with authentic proportions.
